text: 英语输出与阅读搭配手册

IELTS Speaking Part 3  |  TOEFL Speaking  |  CET-6 Writing & Translation  |  PhD Interview

rows: 这份资料怎么用  不要从第一页背到最后一页。每天选 3–5 个搭配：先看中文说英文，再用自己的科研、学习或生活经历造句；隔天不看答案复述。会用，比背过更重要。
内容来源说明  优先回收此前对话中讨论过的阅读词汇与表达（如 cosmetic、psychological、physiological、warrant、appeal、account for、bystander effect 等），并补充常见英语搭配。例句围绕电气工程、功率电子、气体传感器、AI/机器学习、科研和日本博士申请。

01  高频固定搭配：先按语法规律记

rows: 核心原则  固定搭配不是一条一条孤立背。先记住后面接 to do、doing、名词还是完整句子，再把常见动词放进去。

text: A. 动词 + to do（不定式）

rows: 想要 / 希望 / 计划做
I hope to pursue a PhD in Japan.
I decided to focus on power electronics.
我决定专注于电力电子。
We need to improve the sensor's stability.
我们需要提高传感器的稳定性。
I am learning to use COMSOL.
The sensor failed to detect a weak signal.
传感器未能检测到微弱信号。
Small sensors tend to be affected by humidity.
小型传感器往往容易受到湿度影响。
I will try to solve the problem.
我会努力解决这个问题。
I am preparing to apply for a PhD program.
我正在准备申请博士项目。

text: B. 动词 + doing（动名词）

rows: We should avoid using noisy data.
我们应该避免使用噪声数据。
I am considering studying sensor materials.
我正在考虑研究传感器材料。
We finished collecting the sensor data.
我们完成了传感器数据采集。
Keep testing the circuit under different loads.
持续测试电路在不同负载下的表现。
I practice speaking English every day.
I suggest comparing three different models.
我建议比较三种不同模型。
I do not mind explaining my project again.
我不介意再次解释我的项目。

text: C. 动词 + 人/物 + to do

rows: The software allows users to view real-time data.
软件允许用户查看实时数据。
The sensor enables us to detect gas changes.
传感器使我们能够检测气体变化。
My supervisor encouraged me to explore this topic.
导师鼓励我探索这个课题。
The experiment requires us to control the temperature.
实验要求我们控制温度。
The program expects students to conduct independent research.
项目要求学生开展独立研究。
Machine learning helps us identify patterns.
机器学习帮助我们识别规律。

text: D. 动词 + 人/物 + 动词原形

rows: The result made me rethink the model.
这个结果让我重新思考模型。
Let me explain the circuit first.
This tool helps me (to) analyze data.
这个工具帮助我分析数据。
容易错的地方  make + 人 + do（主动语态不带 to）；be made to do（被动语态要带 to）。help 后面 do 和 to do 都可以。

text: E. 介词 + 名词 / doing

rows: I am interested in developing gas sensors.
我对开发气体传感器感兴趣。
I am good at analyzing experimental data.
My current work focuses on collecting sensor signals.
我目前的工作专注于采集传感器信号。
Better control can contribute to improving efficiency.
更好的控制有助于提高效率。
I look forward to discussing my research with you.
我期待与您讨论我的研究。
I am used to working with Python.
我习惯使用 Python 工作。
Humidity compensation can prevent errors from increasing.
湿度补偿可以防止误差增大。
I sometimes have difficulty explaining technical ideas in English.
我有时难以用英语解释技术概念。
I spend time reading papers on power devices.
我花时间阅读功率器件论文。
I am responsible for collecting and processing data.
我负责采集和处理数据。

text: F. 高频介词搭配（后面通常接名词或 doing）

rows: We should take humidity into account when testing gas sensors.
测试气体传感器时应考虑湿度。
Pay attention to the change in the output signal.
Temperature has an impact on sensor performance.
温度会影响传感器性能。
Data analysis plays an important role in fault diagnosis.
数据分析在故障诊断中发挥重要作用。
The error may be related to the sampling rate.
误差可能与采样率有关。
The sensor is exposed to different gas concentrations.
传感器接触不同浓度的气体。
Students have access to advanced laboratory equipment.
学生可以使用先进的实验设备。
We can make use of machine learning to classify signals.
我们可以利用机器学习对信号分类。
The algorithm deals with sensor drift.
该算法处理传感器漂移问题。
The model performs well in terms of accuracy.
就准确率而言，该模型表现良好。
Poor calibration may lead to inaccurate results.
校准不充分可能导致结果不准确。
High temperature may result in signal drift.
高温可能导致信号漂移。
The error may result from poor contact.
误差可能由接触不良引起。
These factors may account for the difference.
这些因素可能解释这种差异。

text: 02  高频表达积木：口语、写作和面试都能用

rows: 使用方法  把这些当作句子开头或连接件。先把后面的内容说简单，再逐步加入从句。
I think that independent learning is important.
我认为独立学习很重要。
One reason is that AI saves time.
一个原因是 AI 能节省时间。
This is because the sensor is sensitive to humidity.
这是因为传感器对湿度敏感。
For example, we can use Python to process the data.
例如，我们可以用 Python 处理数据。
As a result, the system becomes more reliable.
因此，系统变得更加可靠。
Although the model is simple, it works well.
虽然模型简单，但效果不错。
If we increase the sampling rate, we may get more data.
如果提高采样率，我们可能得到更多数据。
As long as we test carefully, we can reduce errors.
只要认真测试，我们就能减少误差。
It is important to understand the basic principles.
It is not only about speed but also about reliability.
这不仅关乎速度，也关乎可靠性。
What matters is whether the system works in practice.
重要的是系统能否在实际中工作。
The main problem is that the signal changes over time.
主要问题是信号会随时间变化。
In the long run, regular practice improves fluency.
从长远来看，持续练习能提高流利度。
To some extent, AI can support independent learning.
在某种程度上，AI 能辅助自主学习。
The more we practice, the more confident we become.
练习越多，我们就越自信。

text: 从简单句扩展到从句

rows: I think that AI is useful.
I think that AI can help students understand difficult concepts.
我认为 AI 能帮助学生理解复杂概念。
I use Python because it is useful.
I use Python because it helps me process experimental data.
我使用 Python，因为它能帮助我处理实验数据。
定语从句：名词 + that / which ...
I use a sensor that detects gas.
I am developing a sensor that can detect changes in gas concentration.
我正在开发一种能够检测气体浓度变化的传感器。
Although the task is difficult, I will try.
Although the model is not perfect, it provides a useful baseline.
虽然模型并不完美，但它提供了一个有用的基线。
If I have time, I will practice.
If I have the opportunity, I would like to continue my research in Japan.
如果有机会，我想在日本继续研究。

text: 容易混淆的 to

rows: to 是不定式标志，后接动词原形
I want to study in Japan.
to 是介词，后接名词或 doing
I look forward to studying in Japan.
to 是介词，表示习惯于
I am used to studying alone.
过去常常做，现在不一定
I am willing to learn new methods.

text: 03  阅读词汇回收：以前讨论过的词和短语

rows: 复习提醒  不要只背中文释义。每个词至少记住一个常见搭配，并读出例句。标有“阅读回收”的词来自此前讨论过的六级阅读材料、选词填空材料或阅读错题分析。

text: A. 心理、身体与社会科学

rows: 表面的；装饰性的；美容的
The improvement was only cosmetic; the sensor was still unstable.
这项改进只是表面上的，传感器仍不稳定。
Long-term stress can have psychological effects on students.
长期压力会对学生产生心理影响。
The study examined the physiological response to stress.
研究考察了压力引起的生理反应。
Physical activity can improve students' health.
体育活动能改善学生健康。
阅读可以提高认知能力。
Patience is a useful trait for researchers.
耐心是研究人员的一项有用特质。
The sensor was placed in close proximity to the gas source.
传感器被放置在靠近气体源的位置。
create / serve as a buffer zone
A protective layer can serve as a buffer zone.
保护层可以起到缓冲区的作用。
人口统计特征；人口数据
The study considered the demographics of the participants.
研究考虑了参与者的人口统计特征。
We need more tests to ascertain the cause of the error.
我们需要更多测试来查明误差原因。
The accuracy improved substantially after calibration.
校准后准确率显著提高。
构成……的基础；是……的深层原因
underlie a problem / underlie a theory
Several factors may underlie the change in sensor output.
多种因素可能是传感器输出变化的深层原因。

text: B. 科技、研究与变化

rows: Humidity may be correlated with changes in sensor resistance.
湿度可能与传感器电阻变化相关。
We removed redundant features from the dataset.
我们从数据集中删除了冗余特征。
A hybrid model combines physical knowledge with machine learning.
混合模型将物理知识与机器学习结合起来。
The supervisor oversees the whole research project.
导师监督整个研究项目。
The new model surpassed the baseline in accuracy.
新模型的准确率超过了基线模型。
Some noise may vanish after filtering.
滤波后部分噪声可能消失。
The old laboratory evokes memories of my first research project.
那间旧实验室让我想起第一个科研项目。
The algorithm needs adaptation to different humidity levels.
该算法需要适应不同湿度水平。
PhD students must deal with the rigors of academic research.
博士生必须应对学术研究的严格要求。
A short circuit may cause catastrophic damage to the device.
短路可能对器件造成灾难性损坏。
The professor asked probing questions about my method.
教授针对我的方法提出了深入的问题。
survive under conditions / survive a test
The device must survive high-temperature tests.
器件必须通过高温测试。
Building a reliable system with limited resources is an engineering feat.
在资源有限的情况下构建可靠系统是一项工程壮举。
We examined the interior structure of the device.
我们检查了器件的内部结构。

text: C. 社会、经济与论证类阅读词汇

rows: The government may impose limits on energy use.
政府可能对能源使用施加限制。
Some users may receive an exemption from the fee.
部分用户可能获得费用豁免。
毁灭性的；极具破坏性的
A major power failure can have devastating effects.
大规模停电可能造成严重后果。
The government enacted a new energy policy.
政府颁布了一项新的能源政策。
Notwithstanding the limitations, the model is useful.
尽管存在局限，这个模型仍然有用。
The author asserts that technology changes society.
作者断言技术会改变社会。
We need to determine the cause of signal drift.
我们需要确定信号漂移的原因。
Developing a new device entails time and cost.
开发新器件需要投入时间和成本。
The report compared mortality rates across regions.
报告比较了不同地区的死亡率。
The company has a hierarchical management structure.
这家公司采用层级式管理结构。
Unequal access to education can widen social gaps.
教育机会不平等可能扩大社会差距。
Their effort to improve safety is praiseworthy.
他们改善安全的努力值得称赞。
We excluded abnormal samples from the analysis.
我们把异常样本排除在分析之外。
to some extent / to a large extent
To some extent, the result depends on the dataset.
在某种程度上，结果取决于数据集。
A moderate temperature helps keep the sensor stable.
适中的温度有助于保持传感器稳定。
We should applaud practical solutions to environmental problems.
我们应该赞赏解决环境问题的务实方案。

text: D. 以前阅读讨论过的短语与长句表达

rows: An unfavorable workplace culture can reduce teamwork.
不良职场文化会削弱团队合作。
The bystander effect may prevent people from helping.
旁观者效应可能阻止人们伸出援手。
Diffusion of responsibility can delay action.
责任分散可能延误行动。
The project raises some thorny questions about safety.
这个项目引出了一些安全方面的棘手问题。
Coordinating several experiments can become a scheduling nightmare.
协调多项实验可能变成排期噩梦。
Few students venture to question the result.
很少有学生敢于质疑这个结果。
Progress has halted because the test equipment is unavailable.
由于测试设备不可用，进展已经停滞。
Lagging grid infrastructure can limit renewable energy delivery.
落后的电网基础设施会限制可再生能源输送。
Humidity has a bearing on gas sensor accuracy.
湿度会影响气体传感器的准确性。
使工作岗位变得不再需要
Automation may make some repetitive jobs obsolete.
自动化可能使一些重复性岗位不再需要。
far more complex than is often assumed
比人们通常认为的复杂得多
Power system stability is far more complex than is often assumed.
电力系统稳定性比人们通常认为的复杂得多。
Demand is rising even as energy costs increase.
能源成本上升的同时，需求也在增长。

text: 04  易混淆词汇：看起来像，意思不一样

rows: 记忆方法  不要只背单词的中文意思。把它们放在对比句里，记住它们各自能修饰什么、常跟什么词搭配。
Stress can cause a physiological response.
Physical exercise is good for health.
The change was cosmetic, not fundamental.
The data are worthless without proper labels.
Humidity has an effect on sensor performance.
An economical design reduces material costs.
The discovery was a historic event.
It is sensible to test the circuit first.
The sensor is sensitive to humidity.
The model must adapt to changing conditions.
We adopted a new classification method.
The temperature rises during the test.
The supervisor assured me that the data were safe.
名词：使用机会；动词：访问
Students have access to the laboratory.
暗示；意味着（说话者/文本发出）
The result implies that humidity matters.
We can infer the cause from the data.
The principal reason is poor calibration.
We need to understand the basic principles.
The professor paid me a compliment.
Hardware and software complement each other.

text: 几个特别容易误判的短语

rows: Several factors may account for the result.
几个因素可能解释这一结果。
Besides collecting data, I analyze it.
除了采集数据，我还分析数据。
除一个样本外，其他样本都通过了。
Poor contact results in signal noise.
接触不良导致信号噪声。
Signal noise results from poor contact.
信号噪声由接触不良引起。
have broad appeal / appeal to users
The simple design has broad appeal.

text: 05  六级翻译与阅读常见表达

rows: 建议  这些表达适合六级翻译、作文，也可以迁移到雅思口语和博士面试。注意固定搭配和动词形式。
环境保护值得我们关注。
look at sth. from different perspectives
We should look at AI from different perspectives.
我们应该从不同角度看待 AI。
The research has practical implications for sensor design.
这项研究对传感器设计具有实践意义。
The laboratory provides students with advanced equipment.
实验室为学生提供先进设备。
provide places for leisure and social activities
提供休闲和社交活动场所
Public parks provide residents with places for leisure and social activities.
公园为居民提供休闲和社交活动场所。
New facilities improve conditions for outdoor activities.
新设施改善了户外活动条件。
Green spaces can make cities more beautiful.
绿地可以让城市更加美丽。
The company plans to enter overseas markets.
公司计划进入海外市场。
New products may help the company expand its market share.
新产品可能帮助公司扩大市场份额。
Scientific cooperation can enhance global influence.
科研合作可以提升全球影响力。
Some cultural products feature Chinese elements.
一些文化产品以中国元素为特色。
Reliable products are often favored by consumers.
可靠的产品往往受到消费者青睐。
The equipment was purchased with government funds.
这些设备由政府资金购买。
The bridge was built by local workers.
这座桥由当地工人建造。
使 A 为 B 做准备
Research experience prepares students for doctoral study.
科研经历为学生读博做准备。
Only in this way can we ...
只有这样，我们才能……（部分倒装）
Only in this way can we improve the system.
只有这样，我们才能改进系统。

text: 六级阅读中常见的逻辑表达

rows: Notwithstanding these problems, the project continued.
尽管存在这些问题，项目仍继续进行。
Demand increased even as costs rose.
成本上升的同时，需求也增加了。
To some extent, the results depend on the test conditions.
在某种程度上，结果取决于测试条件。
in a way that takes into account
The system should be designed in a way that takes into account user needs.
系统设计应考虑用户需求。
More than five decades later, the technology remains important.
五十多年后，这项技术仍然重要。
far more ... than is often assumed
The problem is far more complex than is often assumed.
这个问题远比通常认为的复杂。

text: 06  自测：中文提示，自己组织英文

rows: 做题方式  先遮住答案。不要逐字翻译中文，先选对句型，再组织英语。允许使用简单词汇。

text: 01. 我对功率电子很感兴趣。
提示：be interested in doing / sth.
参考答案：I am interested in power electronics.
02. 我正在考虑使用机器学习分析传感器数据。
提示：consider doing
参考答案：I am considering using machine learning to analyze sensor data.
03. 温度会影响传感器的性能。
提示：have an impact on / affect
参考答案：Temperature has an impact on sensor performance. / Temperature affects sensor performance.
04. 我们需要把湿度考虑进去。
提示：take ... into account
参考答案：We need to take humidity into account.
05. 这个算法帮助我们识别异常数据。
提示：help sb. do
参考答案：This algorithm helps us identify abnormal data.
06. 我希望将来在日本攻读博士学位。
提示：hope to do
参考答案：I hope to pursue a PhD in Japan in the future.
07. 虽然模型比较简单，但它很有用。
提示：Although ..., ...
参考答案：Although the model is simple, it is useful.
08. 我正在研究一种能够检测气体的传感器。
提示：名词 + that 定语从句
参考答案：I am studying a sensor that can detect gases.
09. 这项结果值得进一步研究。
提示：warrant further research
参考答案：This result warrants further research.
10. 除了采集数据，我还负责分析数据。
提示：Besides doing, ...
参考答案：Besides collecting data, I am also responsible for analyzing it.
11. 信号噪声可能由接触不良引起。
提示：result from
参考答案：Signal noise may result from poor contact.
12. 只有这样，我们才能提高系统的可靠性。
提示：Only in this way can we ...
参考答案：Only in this way can we improve system reliability.
07  每日复习方法

rows: 第 1 遍：看中文说英文
先遮住英文，自己回忆搭配和句子。
第 2 遍：替换一个信息
把例句中的 AI 换成 sensor，把 study 换成 research。
第 3 遍：换成自己的经历
用自己的课程、实验、项目或博士规划造句。
第二天不看资料，再说一次；卡住的搭配做标记。
第 5 遍：放进真实回答
回答一个雅思 Part 3、TOEFL 或博士面试问题。
最重要的提醒  你不需要一次背完这份资料。先把最常用的 20 个搭配练到能脱口而出，再逐步增加。每学一个搭配，至少自己造 2 个新句子；只会认、不敢用，就还没有真正掌握。
